format: POST /api/v1/ingest/screen: a W-Soft board pushes the words on its screen (WsoftUiModel JSON, as GET /rest/wsoftScreen returns it). Answer 202 {"accepted":true}, unsigned.
source: Hub docs/adr/0010-board-screen-push.md; model from Hardware.Base tools/wsoft-ui/ref.js PRESETS[0] at 6ad166ee65d18e6e38d5d91f0708dcb19651ef8a
status: frozen wire vector, generated once with Python hmac/hashlib (independent of the Hub codec). The Hub test replays it byte for byte.
request_signing: ASCII "scale-models-hub-v1" + LF + key_id + LF + timestamp + LF + nonce + LF + exact UTF-8 request body bytes; HMAC-SHA256 with the 32-byte key sha256(pairing secret)

rules.screen: a JSON object with an integer "page"; every other key is passed to the painter untouched
rules.push_when: the screen JSON changed and at least 3 s since the last push, or 30 s since the last push (keep-alive); only while the Hub state is online; never during a firmware upload
rules.older_hub: 404 means the Hub has no Control room yet: try again after 10 min

hmac_key: sha256 of the UTF-8 bytes of pairing_secret_utf8 (32 bytes)
